candidates.name: amwell
candidates.description: at amwell, we’re all about making healthcare simpler, smarter, and more accessible. our technology connects people to a range of programs including primary and specialty care, behavioral health, and chronic condition management. for almost 20 years, we’ve helped improve health outcomes for millions of people around the world — and we’re just getting started.
candidates.rationale: Amwell is a virtual-care platform offering primary, specialty, behavioral, and chronic-condition care, directly comparable to Teladoc.

votes.rationale: Amwell is a virtual-care platform offering primary, specialty, behavioral, and chronic-condition care, directly comparable to Teladoc.
Direct telehealth competitor: virtual-care platform connecting patients to primary, specialty, behavioral, and chronic care — same product, market, and model.

candidates.name: betterhelp
candidates.description: betterhelp is the world’s largest online therapy service, facilitating millions of video sessions, voice calls, chats, and messages between therapists and members every month. since 2013, our network of over 30,000 licensed, accredited, and board-certified therapists have helped more than 4,000,000 people face life’s challenges and improve their mental health.read how we affected people's lives: www.betterhelp.com/reviews
candidates.rationale: Online platform connecting patients with licensed therapists for virtual mental-health care, directly comparable to Teladoc’s telehealth and behavioral-care services.

votes.rationale: Online platform connecting patients with licensed therapists for virtual mental-health care, directly comparable to Teladoc’s telehealth and behavioral-care services.
Online therapy platform delivering virtual care via licensed clinicians — same telehealth product and business model as Teladoc.

candidates.name: hinge health
candidates.description: hinge health is focused on scaling and automating the delivery of health care, starting with musculoskeletal conditions. leveraging an ai-powered care model, a wearable device, and access to expert clinicians, hinge health delivers personalized, evidence-based care that helps people move beyond pain, improving member outcomes and experiences and reducing costs for clients. the company is headquartered in san francisco, california.we’re hiring! join us at hingehealth.com/careers
candidates.rationale: Digital healthcare platform delivering clinician-led virtual care and chronic-condition management, specializing in musculoskeletal conditions.

votes.rationale: Digital healthcare platform delivering clinician-led virtual care and chronic-condition management, specializing in musculoskeletal conditions.
Digital/virtual-care platform delivering clinician-led care remotely for chronic musculoskeletal conditions; same telehealth market and model as Teladoc.

candidates.name: included health
candidates.description: included health delivers personalized, all-in-one healthcare to millions of people nationwide. we provide healthcare access, answers, and advocacy through a modern experience designed to treat people better—mind, body, and wallet. it’s all included: - virtual and in-person care- system-wide navigation and care coordination- 24/7 support for every clinical and administrative needsour members experience better care, better outcomes, more healthy days, and lower overall costs.
candidates.rationale: Included Health provides virtual care, clinician access, care navigation, and chronic-care coordination, directly overlapping Teladoc’s telehealth and virtual-care platform market.

votes.rationale: Included Health provides virtual care, clinician access, care navigation, and chronic-care coordination, directly overlapping Teladoc’s telehealth and virtual-care platform market.
Virtual care and telehealth platform with care navigation, directly competing with Teladoc for employer/health-plan virtual care.

candidates.name: lyra health
candidates.description: lyra health is the leading provider of workforce mental health benefits, available to more than 17 million people globally. lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care using ai-powered provider matching, personalized support, and a digital platform to deliver evidenced-based support for individuals and teams. lyra quickly connects members to an exclusive network of mental health providers and well-being tools, to address every mental health need and deliver positive outcomes across race and ethnicity. independent peer-reviewed research confirms that lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast. for more information about lyra health’s workforce mental health benefits for employers, visit lyrahealth.com.
candidates.rationale: Digital platform connecting users to clinicians for virtual mental-health care; a specialized telehealth and employer-benefits comparable.

votes.rationale: Digital platform connecting users to clinicians for virtual mental-health care; a specialized telehealth and employer-benefits comparable.
Both are virtual-care platforms connecting patients to clinicians digitally; Lyra's mental-health telehealth directly overlaps Teladoc's virtual care (e.g., BetterHelp) business.

candidates.name: maven clinic
candidates.description: maven clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. through maven enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. through its consumer platform, maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and glp-1 care programs purpose-built for women.founded in 2014 by ceo kate ryder, maven clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including general catalyst, sequoia, dragoneer investment group, oak hc/ft, stepstone group, icon ventures, and lux capital. recognized for innovation and industry leadership, maven has been named to the time100 most influential companies, cnbc disruptor 50, fast company's most innovative companies, and fortune best places to work. learn more at mavenclinic.com
candidates.rationale: Virtual-care platform delivering clinician-led telehealth and chronic-care-adjacent programs, sold to employers and health plans; a direct digital-health comparable.

votes.rationale: Virtual-care platform delivering clinician-led telehealth and chronic-care-adjacent programs, sold to employers and health plans; a direct digital-health comparable.
Virtual clinic/telehealth platform delivering care to patients via employers and health plans — same product and business model as Teladoc, focused on women's health.

candidates.name: omada health
candidates.description: for 15 years, omada health has been in the corner of millions of americans managing chronic conditions. we help our members between doctor visits, providing virtual care that adapts to real life.we partner with employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and government agencies to support their populations across common chronic conditions — from prediabetes, diabetes, and hypertension to muscle and joint pain— all through the convenience of an app. our programs also adapt to provide specialized care for glp-1 journeys.at omada, care isn’t built for perfection. it’s built for real people. our clinically-validated programs combine human connection with modern technology, pairing members with real coaches and care teams.omada’s impact is proven: our outcomes are published in 30 peer-reviewed studies, showing lasting behavior change, reduced healthcare costs, and roi for our partners.our success starts with our people. omada’s strong, inclusive culture has earned us the great place to work certification, and in 2025 we became a nasdaq-listed company — a milestone on our mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.
candidates.rationale: Virtual chronic-condition care platform connecting members to coaches and care teams, comparable to Teladoc’s telehealth and chronic-care services.

votes.rationale: Virtual chronic-condition care platform connecting members to coaches and care teams, comparable to Teladoc’s telehealth and chronic-care services.
Virtual chronic-care platform delivered via app with coaches and care teams, directly overlapping Teladoc's telehealth and chronic-care (Livongo) offerings; same buyers (employers, health plans).

candidates.name: optum
candidates.description: we’re evolving health care so everyone can have the opportunity to live their healthiest life. it’s why we put your unique needs at the heart of everything we do, making it easy and affordable to manage health and well-being. we are delivering the right care how and when it’s needed; providing support to make smarter and healthier choices; and making prescription services easier, while helping you save money along the way. it’s everything health care should be. together, for better health.optum is part of unitedhealth group (nyse: unh).
candidates.rationale: Optum is a broad healthcare-services subsidiary; the description does not establish a primary virtual-care or telehealth platform comparable to Teladoc.

votes.rationale: Optum is a broad healthcare-services subsidiary; the description does not establish a primary virtual-care or telehealth platform comparable to Teladoc.
Diversified health-services conglomerate (PBM, care delivery, analytics); telehealth is a minor offering, not its primary product like Teladoc's.

candidates.name: spring health
candidates.description: at spring health™, we help employers modernize their behavioral health benefits with the most effective, comprehensive solution for employee mental wellbeing. our offering functions as a single front door to any type of care - from digital exercises, to eap services, to coaching, therapy, or medication.we use a proprietary assessment and machine-learning technology to understand all of the conditions a person may be experiencing, and use those results to match them to a care plan personalized to their needs. each member has access to a care navigator to help guide them through their options, assist in booking appointments with therapists, and connect them to domain experts across work-life, legal, or financial services.this innovative, personalized approach to care, paired with a seamless, high-touch member experience makes spring health™ the most holistic, effective behavioral health benefit for modern, people-first employers.suicidal crisis or emotional distress – for immediate help for you or someone else, call 1-800-273-8255. available 24/7.
candidates.rationale: Employer-focused virtual behavioral-health platform delivering digital care, therapy, navigation, and clinician access; a telehealth comparable to Teladoc despite narrower scope.

votes.rationale: Employer-focused virtual behavioral-health platform delivering digital care, therapy, navigation, and clinician access; a telehealth comparable to Teladoc despite narrower scope.
Virtual behavioral-health platform delivering remote therapy and care navigation; a telehealth peer in Teladoc's virtual-care space, also sold via employers.
